description: This file defines the class 'JmsBasedRegistrationClient', which extends a generic JMS-based request-response client. It implements the 'RegistrationClient' interface and provides methods for creating registration clients, asserting registration, and sending custom requests to a device registration service via JMS messaging. The class focuses on interaction with the registration endpoint, handling request message construction, response parsing, and error handling.

classes.name: JmsBasedRegistrationClient
classes.description: A JMS-based client for device registration operations, capable of asserting registrations and sending custom requests, built to communicate with a registration service endpoint via JMS messaging.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new 'JmsBasedRegistrationClient' with provided connection, configuration, and tenant, initializing necessary links.

methods.name: assertRegistration
methods.description: Sends a registration assertion request for a specified device ID, optionally with a gateway ID.

methods.name: assertRegistration (overload)
methods.description: Same as above, with deviceId only.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Constructs and sends a JMS message for a specified operation, properties, and payload, processing the response and handling errors.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Parses the response payload into a 'RegistrationResult' object based on status code and payload content.
